CSV 转 Word——离线、值按写下的字符落地、不上传CSV to Word offline — values keep their characters

两步：`csv>html` 用 `XLSX.read(text, { type: "string", raw: true })` 把文件读成一张表，再交给 `sheet_to_html`；`html>docx` 把这份文档交给 `asBlob` 打成一份真的 `.docx` 容器，内容是一段 MHT altChunk——也就是说**排版发生在 Word 里**，字体、列宽、配色都归打开它的那款软件，不归这条链。`raw: true` 是唯一要紧的一步：不加它，SheetJS 的类型推断器会先改写你的数据，实测同一格 `2024-01-05` 在不 raw 的读取下单元格里写的是 `data-t="n" data-v="45296.33383101852"` 而显示文本是 `1/5/24`，加了 raw 之后 `data-v` 与显示文本都是 `2024-01-05` 那一串字符，`00424` 也不会缩成 `424`。还有一条容易被误以为「转换弄丢了东西」的形状要说清：`sheet_to_html` **不产出表头语义**——实测每一行都是 `<tr><td …>`，没有 `<thead>` 也没有 `<th>`，所以第一行在 Word 里与普通行同样处理，想要「标题行」的外观，请在 Word 里勾选表格标题行或自己套样式。安全那条边界也照实说：这段 HTML 不是由我们渲染的，Word 会在用户机器上解析它，所以远程引用在打包前被整体剥掉（`stripRemoteResources`，含 `//host/x.png` 那种协议相对地址），否则一个远程 `<img>` 就变成由另一个应用发出的跟踪像素，落在 CSP 与离线守卫都看不见的地方；内联 SVG 则在净化**之前**先栅格成 PNG，因为 `html` profile 里没有任何 svg 标签——曾经失败过一次「产物是有效的空 .docx 而批次报成功」。打包失败会报 `errors.docxGen`，不会交出一份打不开的文件。全程在这个标签页里完成，只有 storage 权限。Two steps: `csv>html` reads the file with `XLSX.read(text, { type: "string", raw: true })` and hands it to `sheet_to_html`; `html>docx` gives that document to `asBlob`, which packs a real `.docx` container whose body is an MHT altChunk — meaning **the layout happens in Word**: fonts, column widths and colours belong to whatever opens it, not to this chain. `raw: true` is the step that matters. Without it SheetJS’s inferrer rewrites your data first — measured on the same cell, a non-raw read writes `data-t="n" data-v="45296.33383101852"` and displays `1/5/24`, while the raw read writes and displays `2024-01-05`, and `00424` does not shrink to `424`. One shape that is often misread as the converter losing something: `sheet_to_html` **produces no header semantics** — measured, every row is `<tr><td …>` with no `<thead>` and no `<th>`, so the first row is treated like any other in Word; for a title-row look, mark it in Word or apply a style yourself. The security boundary is stated rather than glossed: this markup is not rendered by us — Word parses it on the user’s machine — so remote references are stripped before packing (`stripRemoteResources`, including protocol-relative `//host/x.png`), because otherwise one remote `<img>` becomes a tracking pixel issued by a different application, outside both the CSP and the offline guards. Inline SVG is rasterised to PNG **before** sanitising, since the `html` profile contains no svg tag at all — the earlier failure produced a valid but empty `.docx` while the batch reported success. A packing failure reports `errors.docxGen` instead of handing back a file that will not open. All of it inside this tab on the storage permission.

共 2 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。2 steps, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 值按文件里写下的字符落地：`00424`、`2024-01-05`、`1/2` 都不被推断成数字或日期（实测 `raw: true` 下 `data-v` 与显示文本一致）Values land as the characters the file carries: `00424`, `2024-01-05` and `1/2` are not inferred into numbers or dates (measured: with `raw: true`, `data-v` and the displayed text agree)
  • 一张表进一份文档：CSV 只有一个工作表，产物里就是一张表，不会莫名多出第二张One table in one document: a CSV has a single worksheet, so nothing extra appears as a second table
  • 单元格里的文字内容保留：`sheet_to_html` 写出的是格子里的字，不是重新格式化后的显示串The words inside cells are kept: `sheet_to_html` writes what is in the cell rather than a re-formatted display string
  • 远程引用被剥净再交给 Word：这条链不把「打开即发请求」的风险写进产物Remote references are stripped before Word sees the markup, so this chain does not write an open-and-request risk into the artifact

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 没有表头语义：实测每行都是 `<td>`，既无 `<thead>` 也无 `<th>`，所以 Word 不会知道你的第一行是标题行（要那个外观，请在 Word 里勾「标题行」或自己套样式）No header semantics: measured, every row is `<td>` with no `<thead>` and no `<th>`, so Word is not told your first row is a title — tick “Header Row” there or style it yourself for that look
  • 排版不由这条链决定：altChunk 意味着 Word 负责字体、列宽与分页，同一份 CSV 在不同软件里可能排得不一样The layout is not this chain’s decision: an altChunk means Word owns fonts, column widths and pagination, so the same CSV can lay out differently in different software
  • 数字类型不迁移：这里不恢复数字与日期类型（那是 CSV→Excel 那条按值取数的路），文档里就是一格一格的字Numeric types do not travel: nothing here restores number or date types (that is what CSV to Excel does with its round-trip typing rule), so the document holds words per cell
  • 指向网络或相邻路径的图片取不到字节，且远程引用会被剥掉，所以图不会出现在文档里；文字数据不受影响Images pointed at the network or a sibling path have no bytes and remote references are stripped, so no pictures appear; the text data is unaffected
  • 样式与公式不携带：CSV 本身没有格式，条件格式、批注、冻结窗格这些概念在这条链上没有任何对应物Styling and formulas are not carried: a CSV has none, and conditional formatting, comments or frozen panes have no counterpart on this route

实操提示Working with it

  • 要可计算的电子表格：CSV→Excel，那条链会把确实是数字的格按「逐字节回得来」的规则还原For a computable spreadsheet: CSV to Excel, whose round-trip rule gives genuine numbers their type back
  • 要一份能贴进既有模板的文档：先转 HTML，再由你在 Word 里套样式，比指望这里携带格式更稳For something that must fit an existing template: convert to HTML first, then apply your Word style there — more dependable than expecting styling to travel
  • 只是想要一份可读的纯文本表：CSV→TXT / CSV→Markdown，竖线排版在 Markdown 里还能继续编辑For a readable plain-text table: CSV to TXT or Markdown, where the pipe layout stays editable

常见问题Questions people actually ask

第一行是表头，Word 里会显示成表头吗？My first row is a header — will Word show it as one?

不会自动。实测 `sheet_to_html` 每行都写成 `<td>`，没有 `<th>`，所以文档里没有「这是标题行」这个信息；Word 只会把第一行当成普通行（你可以勾标题行或给它套样式）。反过来说，这也意味着任何一行都能被安全地当成数据行处理，不会因为样式而错位。Not automatically. Measured, `sheet_to_html` writes every row as `<td>` with no `<th>`, so the file carries no “this is the title row” information and Word treats the first row like any other — tick Header Row or style it. The flip side: no row is special, so nothing shifts because of header styling.

为什么我的日期在 Word 里不是日期格式？Why is my date not a date format in Word?

因为这条路刻意不猜类型。CSV 里 `2024-01-05` 只是一串字符，把它「还原成日期」正是把 `1/2` 变成某年某月某日、把邮编 `00424` 变成 `424` 的那一步。所以要的是可计算的日期列，请走 CSV→Excel 那条按值取数的路，而不是让文档替你做这个决定。Because this route deliberately guesses nothing. In a CSV `2024-01-05` is characters, and “restoring” it is exactly the step that turns `1/2` into a calendar day and the zip `00424` into `424`. For real date columns take CSV to Excel with its round-trip rule rather than letting a document make that decision for you.

转换后的 .docx 会被 Word 拦住吗？Will Word block the resulting .docx?

产物是一份正常的 OPC 容器，能像其他 .docx 一样打开；它的正文以 altChunk 形式内嵌，排版由 Word 完成。需要说明的是：远程引用在打包前已被剥净，所以 Word 打开时不会去取文档外的东西。若打包那一步失败，界面报的是转换错误，不会给你一份打不开的文件。It is an ordinary OPC container that opens like any other .docx, with its body carried as an altChunk that Word lays out. The point worth stating: remote references are stripped before packing, so Word has nothing outside the file to fetch. If packing fails, the interface reports a conversion error instead of handing you an unopenable file.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
